questions.q: Abnormal uterine bleeding is classified by FIGO using the acronym:
questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. PALM (structural: polyp, adenomyosis, leiomyoma, malignancy) and COEIN (non-structural).

questions.q: Kent's Repertory contains how many chapters?
questions.why: Kent's Repertory runs in 37 chapters, from Mind to Generalities.

questions.q: Sciatica with cramping pain, worse on the left, relieved by heat and pressure, suggests:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Colocynth: cramping pains, better pressure.

questions.q: The Drugs and Cosmetics Act, which also governs homoeopathic medicines, was passed in:
questions.why: The Act dates from 1940. The Drugs and Cosmetics Rules followed in 1945.

questions.q: Acute nephritis or dropsy with oedema, scanty urine and thirstlessness, with stinging pains, suggests:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Apis: oedema, thirstless.

questions.q: Enlarged red cells containing Schuffner's dots on a peripheral smear are seen in infection with:
questions.why: P. vivax (and P. ovale) infect young red cells, which enlarge and show Schuffner's dots; P. falciparum shows Maurer's clefts.

questions.q: The 'Bolam test' in medical negligence holds that a doctor is not negligent if:
opts: the patient had signed a written consent form
he acted in accordance with a practice accepted as proper by a responsible body of fellow practitioners
the outcome of the treatment was favourable
he had charged no fee for the treatment
questions.why: Bolam v. Friern Hospital (1957): the standard of care is that of a responsible body of skilled practitioners in that field.

questions.q: The Human Development Index does NOT include (GPSC Medical Officer, 2025):
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. IMR is part of the PQLI, not the HDI.

questions.q: Lack of self-confidence with a domineering manner at home, flatulence, right-sided complaints and aggravation from 4 to 8 p.m. indicate:
Which miasm did Hahnemann call the oldest, most universal and the mother of countless chronic diseases (§80)?
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. §80: psora is the oldest, most universal and most pernicious chronic miasmatic disease.
